notes: Fix: Hinglish transcription stuck with the graphics card and processor both idle (English worked). If a file of the Hinglish model's folder (for example tokenizer.json) was missing, the speech engine silently waited for the internet, for minutes when the connection was blocked or slow. The folder is now checked before it is used, a missing small file is put back from a copy inside the app (nothing is downloaded, the model itself is unchanged), and a folder that cannot be repaired is reported in plain words instead of waiting.

Fix: the speech model that is already downloaded is now loaded from the computer only, without first asking the internet whether a newer version exists. A slow or blocked connection no longer delays it.

New: the progress text now names what the program is doing ("Loading the speech model from disk", "Pass 2: the Hinglish model is listening…", "Extra check 1…"). If nothing happens for 90 s it says which step it is waiting in, and after 2 minutes it saves a report to work\stall_trace.txt that 'Copy support info' (section 10) includes, so a stall can be pinned down.
Improved: the system check shows "Hinglish model incomplete" with a one-click Fix (no download) when such a file is missing.
